name: URY Document Register
query:
SELECT document_code AS `Document Code`, title AS `Title`, category AS `Category`, document_type AS `Type`, status AS `Status`, current_revision AS `Revision`, branch AS `Branch`, restaurant AS `Restaurant`, expiry_date AS `Expiry Date`, document_owner AS `Owner`
FROM `tabURY Controlled Document`
WHERE (%(branch)s IS NULL OR branch = %(branch)s)
  AND (%(restaurant)s IS NULL OR restaurant = %(restaurant)s)
  AND (%(category)s IS NULL OR category = %(category)s)
  AND (%(status)s IS NULL OR status = %(status)s)
ORDER BY modified DESC
